summary: Full backend + frontend E2E for Waste2Earn MVP. Backend pytest suite (20 tests) covering auth, dashboard, positive analyze with real bottle JPEG, all negatives (blank/unsupported/invalid-file), LLM failover (test_mode=quota -> gemini fallback confirmed), pending reward, recyclers, pickup+QR, verify mismatch/success/duplicate, wallet, activity, notifications, recycler demo: 20/20 PASS (100%). Frontend E2E verified: dev_token auto-login, Home dashboard (greeting, metrics, monthly goal, how-it-works, find-recycler, rewards card, recent scans, theme selector), instant theme switch across Green/Blue/Dark/Pastel, 5-tab bottom nav (Home/Upload/Rewards/Recycler/Profile), Recycler list with Schedule Pickup, verify screen 'Simulate Recycler Scan' -> reward-credited screen shows ₹total, 15% commission, net earning; wallet balance increased by exact net credit; Recent Scans filter chips; Notifications screen. No red-screen errors. Providers verified: analyze returned provider=openai:gpt-5.4 for real image, gemini:gemini-3-flash-preview for test_mode=quota.

issues: Camera preview area is empty black on web (expected: expo-camera requires native build). Fallback 'Enable Camera' button + 'Simulate Recycler Scan' properly provided.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated for RN 0.76+.
Warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.
Animated: `useNativeDriver` is not supported on web - falls back to JS animations (harmless on web preview).

action_items: (Optional) Migrate 'shadow*' StyleSheet props to boxShadow to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py verify_pickup returns new_wallet_balance computed from stale user dict (user.get('wallet_balance',0)+credit) instead of re-fetching after $inc. Value matches only when the caller had fresh user state; consider re-fetching for accuracy.
test_mode form field is a production-exposed harness on /api/scans/analyze; ensure it is disabled or restricted in production deployments.
storage_helper failures are swallowed silently for image upload; consider recording a failure code so scans w/o image can be diagnosed.
verify_pickup does not use a transaction, so partial failures between rewards update, ledger insert, users $inc could leave inconsistent state under concurrency.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the auto-seeded demo account demo@waste2earn.app + /tmp/bottle.jpg downloaded from Unsplash for real-image positive analyze test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth via POST /api/auth/dev-login (no body). Front-end route /verify uses param name `id` (NOT pickup_id). Use real feature-rich JPEG for positive scan (checker PNGs get flagged blank by GPT-5.4). Backend already implements 15% commission and duplicate-guard correctly.
